sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as Exophase and PSNProfiles publish it. Counts that the description does not state come from PSNProfiles' progress targets. Every guide is our own words, built from the official descriptions; where a method is not yet verified in the game (it released today), the guide says so plainly.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Follow the roadmap in this guide — story first, then side content, then collectibles and cleanup — and the platinum is the last thing you earn.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); our roadmap, built from the official list.

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so it cannot be missed — just play through the intro and the trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Story progression — play through the chapter's missions in order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story progression — complete the chapter's missions and the trophy unlocks at its end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story progression — complete the chapter's missions and the trophy unlocks at its end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story progression — the last chapter before the finale.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Story progression — finish the game's last mission and the gold pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — play it when it appears and the trophy unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — finish the heist and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — finish it and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — finish it and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at the airport — finish the takedown and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — finish it and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The game's completion counter covers story, side missions, activities and collectibles — check the in-game stats page to see what is left, and clear it category by category with this guide's checklist.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); our roadmap, built from the official list.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near-misses and drifts — PSN tracks the count to 250. Chain them during normal driving and in stunt-friendly spots; the count is cumulative across the whole game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (250).

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game counts nine activity types — races, fishing, the arcade, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and challenges — and one try at each is enough.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); our count of the activity types from the official trophy list.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. PSN tracks 42 challenges across the range's disciplines. Learn each discipline's scoring — steady aim beats speed — and replay any challenge until gold.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (42).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. PSN tracks 14 race locations. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win; a win at each location is what counts.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (14).

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts, but each event only counts once — work through 20 distinct race events.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — watch the line tension and reel in steadily rather than yanking.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to its end — one full game is enough.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Finish Andy's story arc — his last mission unlocks once his earlier missions are done. To be safe, finish side-character arcs before the finale.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Finish Kenton's arc; his last mission appears after his earlier ones. To be safe, finish side-character arcs before the finale.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's arc; his last mission appears after his earlier ones.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map — work through eight full strands.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's arc; his last mission appears after his earlier ones.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's arc; his last mission appears after his earlier ones.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. PSN tracks 18 meditation spots. Meditate once at each — the spots are the quiet viewpoints scattered across the state.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (18).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting job and bring down the unique animal he names — track it, approach downwind, and use a scoped rifle.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — collect full sets of three. Use the in-game collection screen to see which cards each set is missing.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK spots are the photo and tag locations across the state — visit 100 of them.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks — work through 50 of them across every category.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Do this while your partner is with you — partner availability is story-gated, so do not leave it until after the finale. Get a 4-star wanted level together, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game. Missable: partner-gated.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Do this while your partner is with you. Hit three shops in a row, keep moving, and do not let the wanted level rise — a fast car and a planned route help.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game. Missable: partner-gated.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 distinct vehicles — each new model you get into counts. Try dealerships, traffic and parked cars across the state.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus in a firefight with at least five enemies close together and drop all five before it ends — a tight group and an automatic weapon help.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a plane at Vice City International Airport and take off without clearance — expect a wanted level, so be ready to fly out fast.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The Rhinos are tanks — this trophy is about dealing with them. The official description gives no step, and no verified guide exists yet for a game a day old, so this guide does not invent one: expect it to involve a Rhino tank, and check back once players have found the trigger.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase). Method not yet pinned down — see the guide.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, go in quiet, and leave before anyone raises the alarm — a silenced weapon and a fast exit help.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vaults, five clean getaways — plan each escape route before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck, crack it open and get away — a quiet road and a fast car make the escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. PSN tracks 52 areas — visit every named area on the map. The in-game map shows which areas you have been to.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (52).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. PSN tracks 9 gangs — hit one illegal operation per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (9).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a showroom's front — pick a showroom, build speed, and go through the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. A story beat about the partnership — play through the story and it unlocks. The exact trigger is not yet pinned down, and this guide does not invent one.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase). Trigger not yet pinned down — see the guide.

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSN tracks a count to 500 — the game counts the choices you make. Some story choices may be one-time, so weigh them; the count is large, so most of it comes from ordinary decisions across the game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (500). Missable: story choices can be one-time.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the second try — a retry feat that comes naturally as you play.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — a one-time story moment or event. Pay attention during story beats; if it is a single event, there may be no second chance.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase). Missable: a one-time story moment.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a slow drive-by with a bat or similar.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); method — our own advice from the description, not yet verified in-game.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until $250,000 is clean — it is cumulative, so keep laundering as you earn.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Cumulative spending — buy cars, clothes, weapons and property until $100,000 is spent.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. PSN tracks 8 garage properties — buy them all.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official trophy description (Exophase); PSNProfiles progress target (8).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles you own in the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
